```{r setup}
DATOS <- params$datos
source("R/tema.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
  library(scales); library(forcats); library(patchwork)
})

# Salvado propio: estas figuras viven en su propia carpeta y no dependen de
# guardar()/guardar_cob(), que estan atados a los datos del RNA largo.
guardar_srna <- function(p, nombre, alto, ancho = 200) {
  dir.create("figuras_srna", showWarnings = FALSE)
  for (ext in c("png", "pdf"))
    ggsave(file.path("figuras_srna", paste0(nombre, ".", ext)), p,
           width = ancho, height = alto, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
}

len <- read_tsv(file.path(DATOS, "lenhist_todas.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
par <- read_tsv(file.path(DATOS, "particion_todas.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = metrica, values_from = valor)

stopifnot(n_distinct(len$muestra) == nrow(par))

# Tramos. El 18-35 es la ventana que analiza el nivel B; dentro, 18-23 es
# siRNA y 24-35 piRNA.
TRAMOS <- c("< 18 nt", "18–23 nt (siRNA)", "24–35 nt (piRNA)", "> 35 nt")
comp <- len |>
  mutate(tramo = factor(case_when(longitud_nt <  18 ~ TRAMOS[1],
                                  longitud_nt <= 23 ~ TRAMOS[2],
                                  longitud_nt <= 35 ~ TRAMOS[3],
                                  TRUE              ~ TRAMOS[4]), levels = TRAMOS)) |>
  group_by(muestra, tramo) |>
  summarise(n = sum(lecturas), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()

# Orden y color: fraccion de piRNA DENTRO de la ventana 18-35, que es la que
# usa el clasificador del nivel B (frac_pi = lecturas piRNA / lecturas mapeadas,
# y solo se mapean las de 18-35). Calcularla sobre TODAS las lecturas hunde a
# las librerias con muchos fragmentos cortos -- del 2 % al 26 % segun la
# libreria -- y deja de ser la variable que confunde al criterio.
# El panel B sigue mostrando la composicion sobre todas las lecturas, que es
# informativa por si misma.
frac_pi <- comp |>
  filter(tramo %in% TRAMOS[2:3]) |>
  group_by(muestra) |>
  summarise(frac_pi = n[tramo == TRAMOS[3]] / sum(n), .groups = "drop")

orden <- frac_pi |> arrange(frac_pi) |> pull(muestra)

comp <- comp |> mutate(muestra = factor(muestra, levels = orden))
len  <- len  |> left_join(frac_pi, by = "muestra") |>
  mutate(muestra = factor(muestra, levels = orden))
par  <- par  |> rename(muestra = libreria) |>
  mutate(muestra = factor(muestra, levels = orden))

col_tramo <- setNames(c(GRIS, PAL[["azul"]], PAL[["naranja"]], TINTA_2), TRAMOS)

eje_lib <- list(
  scale_x_discrete(limits = orden),
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
)
```

## Library profiles

```{r g-srna-librerias, fig.height = 7}
# --- A. perfil de longitudes, normalizado a fraccion de cada libreria
tot  <- len |> group_by(muestra) |> summarise(n = sum(lecturas), .groups = "drop")
lenf <- len |> left_join(tot, by = "muestra") |> mutate(f = lecturas / n)

pA <- ggplot(lenf, aes(longitud_nt, f, group = muestra, colour = frac_pi)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 17.5, xmax = 23.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = PAL[["azul"]], alpha = 0.07) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 23.5, xmax = 35.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = PAL[["naranja"]], alpha = 0.07) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = PAL[["azul"]], high = PAL[["naranja"]],
                        labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
                        name = "24–35 nt") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(10, 45, 5)) +
  labs(subtitle = "A · Length profile, one line per library",
       x = "read length (nt)", y = "of the library's reads") +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.key.width = unit(3, "mm"), legend.key.height = unit(12, "mm"))

# --- B. composicion por tramos
pB <- ggplot(comp, aes(muestra, frac, fill = tramo)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.78, colour = SUPERFICIE, linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_tramo) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.02))) +
  eje_lib +
  labs(subtitle = "B · Composition by size class",
       x = NULL, y = "of all reads", fill = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(colour = NA)))

# --- C. rRNA retirado, sobre las lecturas de 18-35
pC <- ggplot(par, aes(muestra, rrna / lecturas_18_35)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.78, fill = GRIS) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
  eje_lib +
  labs(subtitle = "C · rRNA removed, of the 18–35 nt reads",
       x = NULL, y = NULL)

# --- D. lecturas que mapean al catalogo, separando las que tambien caen en
# AaegL5. Es la contraparte en LECTURAS de que el catalogo es ~87 % huesped,
# medida por una via distinta de la clasificacion de vOTUs.
DEST <- c("Also maps to AaegL5", "Catalogue only")
hit <- par |>
  transmute(muestra,
            `Also maps to AaegL5` = viral_en_genoma / denominador_rpm,
            `Catalogue only` = (con_hit_viral - viral_en_genoma) / denominador_rpm) |>
  pivot_longer(-muestra, names_to = "destino", values_to = "frac") |>
  mutate(destino = factor(destino, levels = DEST))

pD <- ggplot(hit, aes(muestra, frac, fill = destino)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.78, colour = SUPERFICIE, linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c(PAL[["aqua"]], PAL[["azul"]]), DEST)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
  eje_lib +
  labs(subtitle = "D · Reads mapping to the vOTU catalogue",
       x = NULL, y = "of the RPM denominator", fill = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(colour = NA)))

ps <- (pA / pB / pC / pD) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = paste0("Small RNA libraries (", nrow(par), ")"),
    subtitle = paste0("Libraries ordered by their piRNA fraction. ",
                      "The RPM denominator is the 18–35 nt reads after removing rRNA."),
    caption = paste0("A: all reads, before the 18–35 nt filter. ",
                     "D: reads with a hit in the vOTU catalogue, split by whether ",
                     "they also map to the AaegL5 reference genome."))
guardar_srna(ps, "S1_librerias", alto = 240)
ps
```

## Summary table

```{r tabla-srna}
comp |>
  select(muestra, tramo, frac) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = tramo, values_from = frac) |>
  left_join(transmute(par, muestra,
                      `rRNA` = rrna / lecturas_18_35,
                      `To catalogue` = con_hit_viral / denominador_rpm,
                      `Of those, in AaegL5` = viral_en_genoma / con_hit_viral),
            by = "muestra") |>
  left_join(transmute(par, muestra, `Reads (M)` = round(lecturas_todas / 1e6, 1)),
            by = "muestra") |>
  arrange(muestra) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & !matches("Reads"),
                ~ paste0(round(100 * .x, 1), " %"))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## What the small RNA says about each virus

```{r prep-nivelB}
cons <- read_tsv(file.path(DATOS, "nivelB_consenso.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
obj  <- read_tsv(file.path(DATOS, "nivelB_objetivos_anotados.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# La puerta: solo los objetivos interpretables. El consenso cubre las 5,899 +
# el control, y de esas solo 106 son es_virus -- el resto son huesped, oscura,
# rRNA y celular_otro, que satisfacen el perfil de EVE trivialmente (piRNA de
# una hebra y presentes en AaegL5). Sin esta restriccion la figura la dominan
# loci del mosquito.
cons <- cons |> semi_join(select(obj, votu), by = "votu")

CLASES <- c("replica", "virus_mas_piRNA", "EVE_NIRVS",
            "ambiguo", "bajo_umbral", "rrna")
ETIQ_B <- c(replica = "Replicating", virus_mas_piRNA = "Virus + piRNA",
            EVE_NIRVS = "EVE / NIRVS", ambiguo = "Unresolved",
            bajo_umbral = "Below threshold", rrna = "rRNA")
COL_B  <- c(replica = PAL[["azul"]], virus_mas_piRNA = PAL[["aqua"]],
            `EVE_NIRVS` = PAL[["naranja"]], ambiguo = PAL[["violeta"]],
            bajo_umbral = GRIS, rrna = TINTA_2)
names(COL_B) <- ETIQ_B[names(COL_B)]
```

```{r g-srna-virus, fig.height = 9}
# Una fila por especie: de las vOTUs que comparten nombre_virus, la de mas RPM.
# Es el mismo criterio de representante que usa C4 en cobertura.qmd.
rep_v <- cons |>
  filter(!is.na(nombre_virus), nombre_virus != "") |>
  group_by(nombre_virus) |>
  slice_max(rpm_max, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

larga <- rep_v |>
  select(nombre_virus, rpm_max, all_of(CLASES)) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(CLASES), names_to = "clase", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(clase = factor(ETIQ_B[clase], levels = ETIQ_B))

# Orden: primero las que tienen evidencia de replicacion, luego por RPM.
orden_v <- rep_v |>
  mutate(evid = replica + virus_mas_piRNA) |>
  arrange(evid, rpm_max) |>
  pull(nombre_virus)

larga  <- larga  |> mutate(nombre_virus = factor(nombre_virus, levels = orden_v))
etiq_v <- rep_v  |> mutate(nombre_virus = factor(nombre_virus, levels = orden_v))

n_lib <- max(rep_v$muestras, na.rm = TRUE)

pS2 <- ggplot(larga, aes(n, nombre_virus, fill = clase)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, colour = SUPERFICIE, linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(data = etiq_v, aes(x = Inf, y = nombre_virus,
                               label = format(round(rpm_max), big.mark = ",")),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.15, size = 2.5, colour = TINTA_2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COL_B, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.16))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "Small RNA profile of each virus, across all libraries",
       subtitle = paste0("One row per viral species; of the vOTUs sharing a name, ",
                         "the one with most RPM. ", n_lib, " libraries.\n",
                         "Right: maximum RPM of that vOTU in any library."),
       x = paste0("libraries (of ", n_lib, ")"), y = NULL, fill = NULL,
       caption = paste0("Replicating: 21 nt peak, siRNA from both strands, and ",
                        "below half the reads in AaegL5. EVE/NIRVS: one strand, no ",
                        "21 nt peak, and at least half the reads in AaegL5.")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5),
        legend.position = "top",
        plot.margin = margin(5, 28, 5, 5)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(colour = NA)))
guardar_srna(pS2, "S2_virus_srna", alto = max(120, 5.6 * nrow(rep_v) + 45))
pS2
```

## Agreement between the two techniques

```{r g-srna-acuerdo, fig.height = 4.5}
# El motivo viene de la lista preinscrita de objetivos: lo que el ARN LARGO
# dijo de cada vOTU. La clase viene del ARN PEQUENO. Son medidas de cosas
# distintas -- cobertura del transcriptoma frente a perfil de tamano y hebra --
# asi que el acuerdo no es circular.
ETIQ_M <- c(CFAV = "CFAV", PCLV = "PCLV", HTV = "HTV",
            virus_nombrado = "Named virus", virus_like = "Relative (-like)",
            especie_nueva = "New species", pariente_especie_nueva = "Putative new species",
            revisar_evidencia_debil = "Weak evidence",
            EVE_genoma = "EVE in genome", EVE_candidato = "Candidate EVE",
            CONTROL = "Positive control")
# Orden: lo que el ARN largo llamo virus arriba, lo que llamo EVE abajo.
ORDEN_M <- rev(c("CONTROL", "EVE_genoma", "EVE_candidato", "revisar_evidencia_debil",
                 "pariente_especie_nueva", "especie_nueva", "virus_like",
                 "virus_nombrado", "HTV", "PCLV", "CFAV"))

ac <- cons |>
  inner_join(select(obj, votu, motivo), by = "votu") |>
  filter(motivo %in% ORDEN_M) |>
  mutate(motivo = factor(ETIQ_M[motivo], levels = ETIQ_M[ORDEN_M]),
         clase  = consenso,
         clase  = if_else(clase == "MIXTO_replica_y_EVE", "replica", clase),
         clase  = if_else(clase == "no_interpretable_rrna", "rrna", clase),
         clase  = factor(ETIQ_B[clase], levels = ETIQ_B))

n_mot <- ac |> count(motivo, name = "n")

pS3 <- ggplot(ac, aes(y = motivo, fill = clase)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", width = 0.72, colour = SUPERFICIE, linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(data = n_mot, aes(x = 1, y = motivo, label = n),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.3, size = 2.7, colour = TINTA_2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COL_B, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_percent(), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.08))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "The two techniques agree",
       subtitle = paste0("Rows: what the long RNA called each vOTU. Colour: what the ",
                         "small RNA profile says.\nMIXTO counted as replicating. ",
                         "Right: vOTUs in each group."),
       x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        plot.margin = margin(5, 20, 5, 5)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(colour = NA)))
guardar_srna(pS3, "S3_acuerdo", alto = 110)
pS3
```

```{r tabla-acuerdo}
# La cifra que va en el texto: replicacion en lo que el largo llamo virus
# frente a lo que llamo EVE, entre las vOTUs que superan el umbral.
VIRUS_M <- ETIQ_M[c("CFAV","PCLV","HTV","virus_nombrado","virus_like",
                    "especie_nueva","pariente_especie_nueva")]
EVE_M   <- ETIQ_M[c("EVE_genoma","EVE_candidato")]

ac |>
  mutate(grupo = case_when(motivo %in% VIRUS_M ~ "Called virus by long RNA",
                           motivo %in% EVE_M   ~ "Called EVE by long RNA",
                           TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  filter(!is.na(grupo)) |>
  group_by(grupo) |>
  summarise(`vOTUs` = n(),
            `Above threshold` = sum(clase != ETIQ_B[["bajo_umbral"]]),
            `Replicating` = sum(clase %in% ETIQ_B[c("replica","virus_mas_piRNA")]),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(`% of those above threshold` =
           paste0(round(100 * Replicating / `Above threshold`, 1), " %")) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
